# LawVM

> LawVM is an evidence layer for evolving law. Within supported source and operation scopes, it reconstructs point-in-time legal text, records the operations applied, and retains unresolved cases as explicit residuals for review.

LawVM is open-source research software, not an official legal consolidation or legal advice. Frontend maturity differs by source regime. A clean comparison or conformance profile supports only the conclusions permitted by its declared checks and coverage.

## Three entry points

- Source bootstrap: paper, scans, PDFs, or incomplete archives first yield preserved manifestations, extraction witnesses, structure evidence, and a blocked-source map. OCR is an extraction witness, not legal truth; a legitimate stop is an explicit result when the next claim is unsupported.
- Pre-publication QA: a concrete adapter can check a versioned drafting or publication export for target, reference, legal-time, language, and mutation-boundary failures in read-only mode.
- Published-text audit: a bounded amendment corpus can be replayed against a declared published consolidation, with differences routed to human disposition.

Shared decision chain: declared sources and model -> declared QA checks -> strict or observe-only disposition -> named human decision. LawVM does not automatically correct or publish legal text.

Current work is bounded source assessment, frontend-specific replay, and adapter-specific QA. A future strict-authoring profile could make consolidation automatic and machine-checkable only within an accepted formal domain with closed sources, human-text/artifact correspondence, compiler and replay proofs, independent checking, and rejection or blocking of unsupported input. LawVM does not currently discharge that proof, and the institution retains legal and publication authority.

The UK lane is a bounded effects/version workbench with observe-only diagnostics, not a broad automatic-consolidation service. Staging lanes are usable for bounded source and conformance assessments, not production replay integrations.

## Research and explainers

- Finland benchmark snapshot: https://lawvm.org/finland
  - Dated bounded-corpus replay experiment; the public page reports aggregate comparison and source limits only. Individual Finnish candidate-review packets are not published on the site.
- Confirmed Estonia case: https://lawvm.org/cases/estonia-audiitors-95-2
  - Public source-to-replay-to-publisher-correction evidence chain for one Riigi Teataja case.
- Artifacts and reproduction: https://lawvm.org/artifacts
  - Benchmark methodology, frozen snapshot boundary, corpus criteria, and planned aggregate artifact releases.
- Research and citation: https://lawvm.org/papers
  - Research-paper plans, software publication status, and artifact-release scope.
- Truth surfaces: https://lawvm.org/articles/truth-surfaces
  - Distinguishes enacted publication, published artifacts, derived/updated comparison surfaces, and independently replayed text-state.
- Reading benchmark numbers: https://lawvm.org/articles/reading-benchmark-numbers
  - Explains what similarity metrics measure and what they cannot establish.
- Parsing amendment language: https://lawvm.org/articles/parsing-amendment-language
  - Bounded Finnish grammar/parsing demonstration with prior-work links and explicit recovery limits.
- Replay divergence classes: https://lawvm.org/articles/replay-bugs-vs-editorial-artifacts
  - Synthetic patterns for separating replay defects, source pathologies, editorial differences, and candidate comparison-surface issues.
- Corrigenda as operations: https://lawvm.org/articles/corrigenda-as-operations
  - Models published corrections as higher-order operations with provenance and time consequences.
- Structural essay: https://lawvm.org/why-law-is-law-shaped
  - Explains stable identity, typed operations, temporal axes, and the text/semantics boundary.
- Civic principle: https://lawvm.org/the-law-in-force-should-be-knowable
  - States the case for reproducible, point-in-time, auditable statutory text.
- Project status: https://lawvm.org/about/project-status
  - Dated alpha evidence, frontend portfolio, open work, and reliance boundary.

## Technology and documentation

- Standards and ecosystem: https://lawvm.org/technology/ecosystem
  - Positions LawVM beside Akoma Ntoso, ELI, drafting systems, publication platforms, and official portals without implying formal integration.

## Solutions

- Solutions index: https://lawvm.org/solutions/
- Consolidation assurance: https://lawvm.org/solutions/consolidation-assurance
- Parallel official-language review: https://lawvm.org/solutions/multilingual-legislation
- Source readiness: https://lawvm.org/solutions/source-readiness
  - Scan-first sequence: exact images -> OCR witness -> structure benchmark -> source/authority closure -> bounded checks or legitimate stop.
- Drafting and publication checks: https://lawvm.org/solutions/drafting-publication-ci
  - Adapter-specific pre-publication checks over a frozen structured export; no universal drafting/CMS integration is claimed.
- Legal-data conformance: https://lawvm.org/solutions/legal-data-conformance
